claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo and a 'DD MOTOR 10 YEAR WARRANTY' sticker.
No capacity is visible; text on the detergent drawer area is obscured by a black rectangle.
Photos show only a concrete floor; no location markers are visible.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or function correctly
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering on and completing a wash cycle.

risks.risk: Water hoses and filters are damaged or blocked
risks.proof: Close-up photos of inlet and outlet hoses and the pump filter.
risks.if_unproven: as needing hose and filter replacement

risks.risk: 10-year motor warranty is invalid or not transferable
risks.proof: Screenshot of warranty registration or original receipt with serial number.

risks.risk: Age and actual model are unknown; capacity may not be 7kg
risks.proof: Clear photo of the manufacturer's rating label and an unobstructed detergent drawer.

risks.risk: Rust and corrosion extend inside the drum or cabinet
risks.proof: Close-up video of the drum interior and underside around the rusted corners.

risks.risk: Reason for sale indicates a hidden defect
risks.proof: Seller's written reason for sale plus any service history.
risks.if_unproven: as sold for an undisclosed fault

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and running a cycle
Close-up photos of hoses, filters, and the rusted corners
Photo of the manufacturer's rating label and serial number
Warranty document or purchase receipt for the DD motor
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an LG front-load washing machine, so a worst-case price can be set even if it does not work and the warranty is invalid; proof of function and warranty would raise it.
